name: On Guard in Stonetalon
summary: On Guard in Stonetalon directs Alliance travelers from Kaela Shadowspear to Gaxim Rustfizzle at their camp near Windshear Crag. Facing rampant despoilment by the Venture Company, an otherwise unlikely pair—a cautious night elf sentinel and an eccentric gnome tinkerer—join forces to safeguard the mountain pass.

sections.title: An Unlikely Alliance
sections.body: Night elves and gnomes rarely share common ground, especially when it comes to technology and the natural world. In the crags of Stonetalon Mountains, however, necessity bridges the cultural gulf. With the rapacious Venture Company carving out the wilderness and felling ancient trees, the sentinel Kaela Shadowspear has recognized that pure martial prowess alone cannot overcome industrialized pillaging. Welcoming gnome ingenuity into sacred Kaldorei territory demonstrates just how precarious the situation has become.

sections.title: Gnomish Philosophy
sections.body: Gaxim Rustfizzle represents the eccentric pragmatism of the Alliance's smaller allies. While night elf society famously turned its back on arcane excess millennia ago, Gaxim believes that abstaining from magic and technical innovation leaves them vulnerable. By pairing alchemy and engineering with a touch of arcane discipline, Gaxim aims to convince his Kaldorei hosts that practical science can defend nature just as effectively as bow and glaive.

faq.q: Why are a night elf and a gnome working together here?
faq.answer: The Venture Company's destructive deforestation and resource extraction in Stonetalon are so severe that Kaela Shadowspear accepted outside aid. Gaxim brings engineering and alchemical expertise that the night elves typically lack, providing technical support to counter modern industrial machinery.

Gaxim is an adventurous gnome engineer and tinkerer stationed at a camp near Windshear Crag. He believes strongly that the night elves' strict aversion to arcane magic leaves them disadvantaged, seeking to prove that combining engineering, alchemy, and controlled magic can solve even the direst threats.

Kaela Shadowspear is a night elf sentinel tasked with maintaining watch and defense over the Stonetalon Mountains. She serves as a regional commander coordinating resistance against the Venture Company.

faq.q: What threat is the Venture Company posing in Stonetalon?
faq.answer: The Venture Company is an unscrupulous mercantile syndicate cutting down sacred forests, operating destructive drilling rigs, and polluting pristine lands across Stonetalon for rapid commercial profit.

faq.q: Who is Tara, mentioned by Kaela?
faq.answer: Kaela's dialogue uses Tara for the contact who sent you from Astranaar. The preceding quest is given by Sentinel Thenysil; it does not establish a separate quest giver named Tara.

faq.q: Where does this task lead next?
aliases: quest after on guard in stonetalon
faq.answer: After speaking with Gaxim Rustfizzle, he offers 'A Gnome's Respite,' enlisting your aid to secure local supplies and further test his technical solutions against the hazards of the region.

angles.text: Gaxim Rustfizzle proudly represents gnomish ingenuity in Kalimdor, using his presence to demonstrate that science, engineering, and magic can overcome challenges where ancient traditions falter.

For Kaldorei sentinels, trusting a gnome tinkerer who advocates combining engineering with magic requires swallowing considerable pride, reflecting just how devastating the Venture Company's logging operations have become.

Gaxim's mission underscores the practical utility of engineering in frontline reconnaissance and ecosystem defense, proving that cogwheels can serve conservation when turned against unchecked exploitation.
This partnership showcases the broader Alliance ethos in action, as Eastern Kingdoms expertise blends with Kalimdor sentinels to stem shared threats across the frontier.
